_note: Chapter 6: Aldo rows the player across the lake to Corvane (plan item 1407, row choice 1591). Before the Act II card the Act I main-story betrayals are cashed in on the pier.

say: The whole village has come to the pier to watch Aldo row again. Some of them came to watch you.

steps.card: Act II: The Colours of Corvane

say: The ferry slides out over the grey lake. Aldo rows without a word for a while.
Aldo: Mirela's first crossing was in a boat like this. She was younger than you.
Aldo: She sat right where you sit, drawing the shore as it went away.
Aldo: Halfway over, a squall came. She didn't stop drawing. Not once.
Aldo: When we landed, she showed me the page. She had drawn the squall, too.
Aldo: 'If it's on the map,' she said, 'it can't surprise you twice.'
Aldo: I married her the next spring. Nobody was surprised.
The far shore rises out of the mist. Above it, in the northern sky, a pale seam glows.
Aldo: That's the third Rift. The wide one. Mirela's out there somewhere.
